scenarioMapping.CL-005: Partial L3/L4 only: the suite verifies standard recovery/replay requests and unsupported capability rejection with zero write. It does not exercise registered Harness UI/evidence status, nor a complete product operation.
scenarioMapping.CL-032: Partial L3/L4: different synthetic peer information with same ACP contract uses same public-client wire path. No real cross-vendor Harness pair.
scenarioMapping.CL-033: Partial L3/L4: v1/v2 replay and no-replay resume wire/completion distinctions, same-session request windows and v2 snapshot checks. No Node Run, approval-owner, or product mutual exclusion proof.
scenarioMapping.CL-034: Partial L3/L4: list ordering/raw/cursor and typed IDs, unknown fields, and debug redaction are exercised. It does not cover product view projection or safe browser rendering.
scenarioMapping.CL-035: Partial L3/L4 only: protocol negotiation rejects unknown/invalid selections without business retry. The current CL-035 product criterion that create, recovery, and input produce zero business dispatch when no common supported version exists remains unverified; do not infer it from client-layer rejection.
scenarioMapping.CL-036: Partial L3/L4: legal selected lower version follows its own shape; no repeated initialize or business side-effect retry. Real product negotiation presentation remains unverified.
scenarioMapping.CL-037: Partial evidence only: stable v1/v2 schema identities are locally fixed and distinguished from ACP wire versions; actual Harness/version matrix is explicitly not verified.
scenarioMapping.CL-038: Partial L3/L4: new connections recompute capabilities; no upgrade evidence ledger, product traceability UI, or real program upgrade.
scenarioMapping.CL-039: Partial L3/L4: actual protocol/business errors are preserved without retry/downgrade; no real Harness declaration-versus-behavior mismatch case.
scenarioMapping.CL-040: Partial L3/L4: absent standard capability rejects request before write and leaves pending unchanged; no Node/Web user-visible error path.
scenarioMapping.CL-041: Not passed: current tests.md defines a real Windows/Harness/Web interruption, resource convergence, same native identity, queued-input, explicit-continue, and no-replay safety flow. The 17 synthetic public-client tests do not exercise this current product scenario; retain it as unexecuted.
scenarioMapping.CL-047: Partial L3/L4: resume without replay does not claim replay support; replay request is rejected with zero write. It does not test all product entry points or current-connection UI mode.
scenarioMapping.CL-048: Partial L3/L4: synthetic peer name/version differences do not create vendor-specific protocol behavior and capability use has no evidence gate. No real programs or full product admission path.
scenarioMapping.CL-049: Not passed under current wording: legacy client/list/frame boundary assertions exist, but current requirement removes platform content/view/cache caps. They do not establish uncapped platform history/view behavior or stream-to-Web presentation. Reclassify legacy limits as protocol/parser contract only.
scenarioMapping.CL-050: Partial L3/L4: representative EOF, malformed response, deadline, cancellation, and no retry/partial publication paths are covered. Not a full product replay generation, UI completeness, or resource-owner test.
scenarioMapping.CL-051: Partial L3/L4: replay origin is treated as a window, and repeated body is not deduplicated by the client. No view-generation rebuild or cross-load stable identity behavior.
scenarioMapping.CL-052: Partial L3/L4: replay response/snapshot are separated from Run completion facts in the public client. No Node completion or restore authorization test.
scenarioMapping.CL-053: Partial L3/L4: a new connection recomputes capability and foreign/old connection requests are rejected. No real reconnection preserving old resource/approval/command facts.
scenarioMapping.CL-054: Not passed: public-client tests do not include real standard replay through Web view projection. The bounded-view wording is historical; current browser view behavior needs current-scope evidence.
scenarioMapping.CL-055: Not passed: Node environment inheritance/override and secret handling are outside the synthetic public-client suite.
scenarioMapping.CL-056: Not passed: explicit source plus native-session identity and cross-connection coordination are application/Node concerns, outside this suite.
scenarioMapping.CL-057: Not passed: no real Node/Harness process environment or same-source multi-entry coordination was exercised.
scenarioMapping.CL-058: Partial L3/L4: preferred v2, legal selected v1, no downgrade on business error, and per-connection negotiation are covered. Real peer behavior and product presentation remain unverified.
scenarioMapping.CL-059: Partial L3/L4: new public-client connections renegotiate, and chosen-version business failures do not downgrade or retry. Real reconnect, old resources/approvals, and user-facing result remain unverified.
scenarioMapping.CL-060: Not passed: the suite does not exercise a real Harness or complete product new-connection/reconnect high-version-priority flow.
